name: NEAR Intents
rootCause: A wallet funded with 10 USDT drained $3.87M from a BNB Chain vault serving NEAR Intents using valid signed authorizations. After a 48-hour ultimatum, the team announced a full recovery and closed its investigation; the full story of the failure remains unclear.

descriptions.text: A wallet funded with 10 USDT drained $3.87M from a BNB Chain vault serving NEAR Intents using valid signed authorizations. After a 48-hour ultimatum, the team announced a full recovery and closed its investigation; the full story of the failure remains unclear.

NEAR Intents suffered a security incident caused by a bug in the Omni deposit and withdrawal infrastructure’s interaction with its smart contract, with a preliminary loss of approximately $3.8 million. The contract-side vulnerability has been patched, full compensation has been pledged, and the team has reported the incident to law enforcement while working to trace and recover the funds.
